concept.name: aperture fold / delayed landing open
concept.force_task_problem: a freely ballistic body must locally collapse its silhouette to pass a narrow wall aperture without touching it; clearance forces a late asymmetric reopening, which creates a one-foot landing deficit that must be paid after ground acquisition
concept.novelty_vs_prior: unlike Airborne022 the obstacle never grants contact/support; unlike 023/024 there is no anchor or planted tool; unlike 025/027 there is no net/payload custody; unlike 026/030 there is no collision impulse; unlike 028 there is no moving support; unlike 029 there is no midair recoil vector bend. The root remains ballistic while local envelope management alone creates downstream landing debt.
concept.support_law: BOTH_FEET at load; NONE through support break, aperture clearance and late reopening; RIGHT_FOOT only on first catch/crush; BOTH_FEET only after delayed restack
concept.contact_law: aperture contact is NONE in every key and transition; visible clearance is the task. Contact occurs only with ground at K8.
concept.clearance_law: body crosses wall columns x=52..54 only through opening rows 9..20; K4 initiates asymmetric fold before the wall, K5 compacts inside the opening, K6 retains trailing-heel lag after root passage

rig.type: single independent generic ASCII biped plus synthetic wall aperture

keys.label: OFFSET_LOAD
keys.root_note: rear-loaded left start; root sits behind forward shoulder and right-hand swing line
keys.causal_role: establish asymmetric launch load and ordinary ground ownership before the clearance task

keys.label: SUPPORT_BREAK
keys.root_note: root leaves both feet on a committed up-right ballistic lane; no air support appears
keys.causal_role: earned support break; directional commitment cannot be canceled by later local folding

keys.label: OPEN_RISE
keys.root_note: root continues up-right while limbs remain deliberately too open for the upcoming aperture
keys.causal_role: show the clearance problem before solving it; silhouette spends width/height while safely distant

keys.label: APEX_CLEARANCE_READ
keys.root_note: apex occurs before the wall; root path is still ballistic while the open silhouette visibly cannot clear unchanged
keys.causal_role: readable pre-aperture danger beat with no contact; clearance must come from local body organization

keys.label: LEAD_SIDE_FOLD
keys.root_note: lead side folds first: right forearm and right knee retract; trailing side remains later and gives the fold attitude
keys.causal_role: author asymmetrical clearance preparation before the thin wall plane; no endpoint collision used

keys.label: APERTURE_TUCK
keys.root_note: compressed body crosses the wall opening entirely unsupported; root descends slightly while local envelope is minimized
keys.causal_role: solve clearance spatially without obstacle contact or magical support; apex debt turns into descent debt

keys.label: TRAILING_HEEL_CLEAR
keys.root_note: root is past wall but trailing heel stays folded one beat longer; opening too early would clip the lower jamb
keys.causal_role: make clearance debt persist after root passes; local trailing lag is causal, not decorative

keys.label: LATE_LANDING_OPEN
keys.root_note: only after full clearance does the body reopen; right foot reaches for ground late while left side remains high and behind
keys.causal_role: convert clearance success into a landing-preparation deficit; preserve a visible precontact gap

keys.label: RIGHT_TOE_FIRST_CATCH
keys.support_detail: right toe first contact; left foot free
keys.root_note: right toe alone earns support; root continues forward/down past the catch line and left foot remains airborne
keys.causal_role: support-specific costly catch created by delayed reopening rather than a generic two-foot landing

keys.label: UNILATERAL_CRUSH
keys.support_detail: right sole load deepens; left foot remains probe
keys.root_note: root drops and overruns the planted right foot; left leg is still a probe, torso remains diagonally behind the brake
keys.causal_role: pay vertical and forward velocity through one-sided compression rather than float or instant stabilization

keys.label: SECOND_SUPPORT_LAG_OVER
keys.support_detail: left foot joins late; staggered restack
keys.root_note: left foot finally joins after the crush; right arm and shoulder overshoot downward while pelvis begins to rise
keys.causal_role: separate support restack from secondary-body lag; recovery cannot be reverse interpolation

keys.label: DISPLACED_SETTLE
keys.root_note: body settles right of the aperture with a wider stance and slightly retained right-side drop; launch address is not restored
keys.causal_role: finish at a reusable but displaced state that remembers clearance and landing debt

transitions.law: support break is authored, not tweened
ballistic rise connector; support remains NONE
nonuniform decelerating rise into pre-aperture apex
root advances while local fold initiates before wall
fast envelope collapse into aperture; no contact
ballistic descent continues while trailing fold lags
clearance exits before late landing opening
ground support acquisition is an authored causal key
right support remains fixed while root compresses/overruns
second support acquisition is authored, not interpolated
both-foot topology persists while secondary lag resolves

motion_dungeon.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS + DIRECTION PROFILE -> DETERMINISTIC CONNECTIVE MOTION -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SPA
motion_dungeon.generic_transition_boundary: connectors may interpolate geometry only while support/contact topology is unchanged; support break/acquisition and second-support entry are zero-frame authored boundaries

quality_iterations.defect: the one-column aperture wall under-read as a punctuation seam rather than a spatial constraint
quality_iterations.correction: same-body task-geometry correction: thicken synthetic wall to x=52..54 while preserving the exact authored body keys, timing, support topology, root arc and no-contact law

quality_iterations.visible_readback: three-column wall makes the slot unambiguous; K3 is visibly open and separated, K4 folds before the wall, K5 stays entirely inside the opening with no contact/support, K6 retains trailing-heel lag, K7 opens late with precontact gap, K8 earns right-toe catch, K9 pays unilateral crush, K10 carries shoulder/arm overshoot into delayed second support, K11 settles displaced

noodle_queen.reason: open rise → specific asymmetric pre-wall fold → compressed aperture silhouette → trailing-heel delay → late long landing-open → one-sided toe catch/crush → upper-body overshoot → displaced wide settle is readable as a performed clearance problem rather than placeholder jump motion
